verdict.rationale: Bento documents its own Data Deletion Requests API, which queues anonymization of a subscriber by email for a specific site. That gives programmatic per-person deletion, but the pack shows no configurable retention policies or automatic data expiry. missing for 10: configurable retention periods/policies, account- or bulk-level deletion controls, detail on what anonymization removes and its timelines, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Use this endpoint to queue anonymization of a visitor (aka a subscriber or user) by email for a specific site.
